description: This file defines the internal sealed partial class 'CallbackData' which manages callback state, timeout, cancellation, and lifecycle events for message responses within Orleans runtime. It includes methods for handling status updates, cancellations, timeouts, target silo failures, and response processing.

classes.name: CallbackData
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, timeout, cancellation, and response handling for a callback associated with a message in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: SubscribeForCancellation
methods.description: Registers a cancellation callback with the provided CancellationToken.

methods.name: OnStatusUpdate
methods.description: Updates the last known status response.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the callback has expired based on the current timestamp.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event, signaling cancellation and completing the response exceptionally.

methods.name: OnTargetSiloFail
methods.description: Handles failure of the target silo, completing the response with an exception.

methods.name: DoCallback
methods.description: Executes the callback with the response message, handling success and rejection responses.
